body.description: Points is the currency of SHARE Program. SHARE Program members will earn SHARE points for their qualified Behaviors, Influences and Transactions (BITs)  with MAF Group companies, as well as external Partners, based on SHARE Program's Reward Rules. SHARE Program members can redeem Points in a variety of ways including making payments, donating to charity, purchasing value-added bundled products, transferring to family members or Staff and even Tipping out into Partner Loyalty Programs, etc.

Status Points is the currency of Share Program. Share Program members will earn Status Points for their qualified Behaviors, Influences and Transactions (BITs)  with MAF Group companies, as well as external Partners, based on Share Program's Reward Rules. Status Points balance determines Share members' Tier status, which in turn unlocks one or more exclusive Benefits for Share Program members.
